in_marathi.name: Dharu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Symbol of strength and support, representing the foundation of life. The name Dharu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhru’, which means ‘support’, ‘foundation’, or ‘that which holds’. This powerful name is associated with the earth element and the root chakra, instilling a sense of stability, grounding, and security.
